# Briefs

> Every build brief for SHarness, published in full before the work: the ask, the design, the acceptance criteria, the owner.

*Source: <https://sharness.ai/admin/briefs/index.html> · generated by tools/gen_admin.py from content/admin/, so the page and this file cannot drift. Every page on this site has a .md twin.*

---

Every brief, published in full before the work, newest first: the ask in the editor's words, the design, numbered acceptance criteria, the owner, and what it does not do. A brief is one file under `content/admin/briefs/`, `YYYY-MM-DD__brief__<slug>.md`; its status is proposed, accepted (the editor's go), built or superseded. The conductor writes one for every improvement it maps; any member may write one. 8 brief(s), as of 29 Oct 2026.
